content.short: Laso Finance is the privacy-maximizing crypto prepaid card.
content.description: Laso Finance offers crypto prepaid Visa cards funded by stablecoins, letting users load funds and spend without disclosing personal information. These cards are usable wherever prepaid cards are accepted, enabling convenient spending with funds loaded as stablecoins. To maintain security and compliance, Laso Finance deploys advanced compliance technology that combines on-chain transaction data, device fingerprinting, and card spending behavior to monitor activity and help deter money laundering and other illicit activities.
